d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav ke pahle charan ka matdan hone ko hai. bihar men kangres aur aarjedi milkar chunavi maidan men hain. bihar se juri rajniti men kangres neta kanhaiya kumar bhi ek aham chehra hote hain. vo bihar chunav, rahul gandhi, bijepi aur prashant kishor ki chunauti par vo kya kahte hain. dekhie bibisi sanvaddata rajnish kumar ki kanhaiya kumar ke sath khas batchit.
Vidiyoh devesh chopra
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
